deficiencies.description: The rewrite converts the lecturer's pointing words ('the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus') into a specific spatial relationship ('lies next to') that is not stated in the source text.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

deficiencies.description: The word 'circumspect' was replaced with 'circumscribed' without an entry in the corrections list.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour is therefore circumscribed and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.

considerations.sourcePassage: and has, if you like, invaded within this tissue
considerations.reason: The phrase 'in a sense' in the rewrite accurately preserves the hedge 'if you like'.

considerations.sourcePassage: interleaving within that, you have these stripes of the malignant tumor that are within the normal muscle
considerations.reason: The rewrite rephrases the description as 'interleaved within it are stripes of the malignant tumour lying within the normal muscle', which conveys the exact same meaning.

considerations.sourcePassage: you wouldn't be sampling all over the body
considerations.reason: The phrasing 'the whole body would not be sampled' captures the meaning of the spoken phrase without adding or distorting facts.
